question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either implementation, but the durable product choice is whether future recoverability is worth longer-lived pending rows and the operator-surfacing burden.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing defect and exact-head validation are addressed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger and operator surface are designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a visible doctor, UI, or API path before changing ambiguous delivery rows to stay pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing defect and exact-head validation are addressed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the same outbound recovery tradeoff and merged/co-authored the broad related rewrite.
